cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), her classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10), Mum, Dad and the puppy Max. Hobbies shown being done; things for hobbies shown on their own.

words.en: Drawing is my favourite hobby.
words.sz: 画画是我最喜欢的爱好。
words.scene: Lily, Tom and Sam each busy with a different hobby at a big table: Lily painting a picture, Sam making a model boat, Tom building tall blocks, Max asleep under the table.
more: Reading is a good hobby.
阅读是个好爱好。
What's your favourite hobby?
你最喜欢的爱好是什么？

words.en: Sam likes to collect stamps.
words.scene: Tom carefully putting a stamp into a big book on the table, small boxes of old coins and shiny shells beside him, Lily watching with her chin on her hands.
more: We collect leaves in autumn.
我们秋天收集树叶。
Tom collects toy cars.
Tom 收集玩具汽车。

words.en: Dad has a new camera.
words.scene: One black camera with a big round lens standing on a table, its flash on top and a strap lying beside it.
more: This camera is very old.
这台照相机很旧了。
Can I use your camera?
我能用你的照相机吗？

words.en: Mum takes a photo of Max.
words.scene: Mum holding up one big photo of a small puppy on the grass, Lily and Tom beside her pointing at it and laughing.
more: Look at this photo!
看这张照片！
We take photos in the park.
我们在公园里拍照。

words.en: Lily can draw a horse.
words.scene: Lily sitting at a desk drawing a big brown horse on a sheet of paper with a pencil, looking pleased with her picture.
more: Draw a sun on your paper!
在你的纸上画个太阳！
Tom draws birds with red pencils.
Tom 用红铅笔画小鸟。

words.zh: 画（颜料画）；刷漆；颜料；油漆
words.en: Lily paints a big red boat.
words.sz: Lily 画了一只红色的大船。
words.scene: Lily and Sam at a table painting a big red boat with brushes, pots of blue, red and yellow paint in front of them, their fingers colourful.
more: Mum paints the door blue.
妈妈把门漆成蓝色。
We need blue paint.
我们需要蓝色颜料。

words.en: Lily likes to dance with Mia.
words.sz: Lily 喜欢和 Mia 一起跳舞。
words.scene: Lily and Mia dancing on tiptoe in a bright room, arms up in the air, a small radio playing on a chair beside them.
more: They dance to the music.
他们跟着音乐跳舞。
This dance is easy.
这支舞很简单。

words.en: Lily listens to music.
words.scene: Lily sitting on the floor with big headphones on her ears, eyes shut and smiling, music notes floating around her head.
more: The music is very loud.
音乐很响。
Mum plays music in the kitchen.
妈妈在厨房里放音乐。

words.en: Lily wants to be a musician.
words.scene: A grown-up woman musician playing the violin on a small stage under warm lights, a music stand in front of her, her eyes closed.
more: Sam's uncle is a musician.
Sam 的叔叔是音乐家。
That musician plays the guitar well.
那名乐手吉他弹得很好。

words.en: Sam plays the guitar.
words.scene: One brown wooden guitar leaning against a chair, its six strings and round sound hole clearly shown.
more: I have a small guitar.
我有一把小吉他。
Can you play the guitar?
你会弹吉他吗？

words.en: This CD has twenty songs.
words.sz: 这张光盘里有二十首歌。
words.scene: Lily holding one shiny round silver disc with a hole in the middle up to the light, rainbow colours on it, its thin square plastic case open in her other hand.
more: Listen to this CD!
听听这张光盘吧！
This CD is new.
这张光盘是新的。

words.en: Put the CD in the CD player.
words.sz: 把光盘放进 CD 播放机里。
words.scene: One silver CD player on a wooden shelf with its round tray open and a shiny disc in it, two small loudspeakers beside it.
more: Our CD player is very old.
我们的 CD 播放机很旧了。
The CD player doesn't work.
CD 播放机坏了。

words.en: Sam plays a video game.
words.scene: Sam sitting on the sofa holding a small white game control with both hands, eyes on a big television screen showing a green hill and a small car, Tom watching beside him.
more: I don't like this video game.
我不喜欢这个电子游戏。
Tom watches Sam play a video game.
Tom 看 Sam 玩电子游戏。

words.en: Mum reads a magazine every week.
words.scene: One glossy magazine lying open on a sofa, its cover showing a big photo of a red bird, a cup of tea next to it.
more: This magazine is about birds.
这本杂志是关于鸟的。
Lily's magazine is on the table.
Lily 的杂志在桌子上。

words.en: Our class has a quiz.
words.sz: 我们班有一场知识问答比赛。
words.scene: Children in a bright classroom putting up their hands to answer, the teacher at the front smiling, a board behind her with only simple pictures on it.
more: Tom wins the quiz at school.
Tom 在学校的小测验中获胜。
We answer ten questions in the quiz.
我们在问答中回答十个问题。

words.en: Mia is in the art club.
words.sz: Mia 参加了艺术俱乐部。
more: Our photo club meets on Tuesday.
我们的摄影俱乐部星期二聚会。
Tom goes to the chess club.
Tom 去国际象棋俱乐部。

words.en: Lily is a member of our art club.
words.sz: Lily 是我们艺术俱乐部的会员。
more: Every member has a red cap.
每个会员都有一顶红帽子。
Sam is a member too.
Sam 也是会员。

words.en: Lily wants to join the art club.
words.sz: Lily 想加入艺术俱乐部。
words.scene: Lily standing at the door of a bright art room, a grown-up teacher waving her in with a smile, children painting at tables inside.
more: Can I join your game?
我能加入你们的游戏吗？
Sam joins the guitar club on Friday.
Sam 星期五加入吉他俱乐部。

words.en: We play football in the park.
words.scene: Lily, Tom and Sam playing football on the green grass of a park, big trees and a duck pond behind them, Max running after the ball.
more: Lily walks her dog in the park.
Lily 在公园里遛狗。
The park near our house is big.
我们家附近的公园很大。

words.en: Don't park the car here!
words.scene: Dad parking the family car carefully in a parking space outside a shop, reversing between white lines, Lily and Mum waiting on the pavement.
more: Dad parks the car near the shop.
爸爸把车停在商店附近。
Mum can park the car in the garage.
妈妈能把车停进车库。

words.en: We camp in the forest on Sunday.
words.sz: 我们星期天在森林里露营。
words.scene: Lily and Tom in pyjamas climbing into a big green tent at the edge of a dark forest, Mum and Dad sitting on low chairs beside it, stars in the sky above.
more: Lily and Tom camp in the garden.
Lily 和 Tom 在花园里露营。
Do you want to camp here?
你们想在这里露营吗？

words.en: We go camping in the summer.
words.scene: A green tent on the grass beside a calm lake on a summer morning, Mum cooking at a small fire in front of it, Lily carrying a big bag to the tent.
more: Camping is great fun.
露营非常有趣。
Sam goes camping with his class.
Sam 和同学一起去露营。

words.en: Our campsite is next to the lake.
words.scene: A campsite with three tents on the grass among trees, two logs by a small fire, a quiet lake and low hills in the distance.
more: Dad finds a good campsite.
爸爸找到一个好的营地。
The campsite is quiet at night.
夜里营地很安静。

words.en: Our tent is big and green.
words.scene: One big green tent standing on the grass, its door rolled open so you can see two yellow sleeping bags inside, a small lamp beside it.
more: Lily sleeps in the tent.
Lily 睡在帐篷里。
Dad puts up the tent in the garden.
爸爸在花园里搭帐篷。

words.en: We go to a food festival in town.
words.sz: 我们去城里参加美食节。
words.scene: A summer festival in a field: a small stage with a band playing guitars, colourful flags over the crowd, Lily and Tom dancing on the grass in front.
more: Lily sings at the school festival.
Lily 在学校艺术节上唱歌。
The summer festival is in July.
夏天的那个节日在七月。

words.en: We visit the museum on Saturday.
words.sz: 我们星期六参观博物馆。
words.scene: Lily and Tom looking up at a big dinosaur model in a museum hall, a kind guide smiling beside them, tall windows and stone steps behind.
more: The museum is big and old.
那座博物馆又大又老。
Mia draws in the museum.
Mia 在博物馆里画画。

words.en: Our class has a party next week.
words.sz: 我们班下个星期有一个聚会。
words.scene: Children at a class party around the tables with cakes, colourful balloons tied to the chairs, Lily clapping and Tom wearing a paper hat.
more: Mia is coming to my party.
Mia 要来参加我的聚会。
We sing songs at the party.
我们在聚会上唱歌。

words.en: Let's go out on Saturday!
words.scene: Mum and Dad putting on their coats to go out in the evening, Lily holding the front door open for them, Tom waving from the stairs, warm light in the hall.
more: We don't go out when it rains.
下雨时我们不出去玩。
Mum and Dad go out on Friday evenings.
爸爸妈妈星期五晚上外出。

words.en: We go shopping at the supermarket.
words.scene: Mum and Lily pushing a big shopping trolley down a supermarket aisle, tall shelves of food on both sides, Tom sitting in the trolley holding an orange.
more: Mum goes shopping every Saturday.
妈妈每个星期六都去购物。
Do you want to go shopping with me?
你想和我一起去购物吗？

words.en: We go to the beach on holiday.
words.scene: The family arriving for their holiday: Lily and Tom jumping out of a car full of bags, a tent on the roof, small hotels and the blue sea behind them.
more: Our holiday is in July.
我们的假期在七月。
We swim every day on holiday.
假期里我们每天都游泳。

words.en: We have our picnic under a tree.
more: Lily brings juice to the picnic.
Lily 带果汁去野餐。
What a lovely picnic!
多愉快的野餐啊！

words.en: We have a barbecue at the campsite.
more: Grandpa cooks fish on the barbecue.
爷爷在烧烤架上烤鱼。
The food on the barbecue is nice.
烧烤的食物很好吃。

words.en: We swim at the beach on holiday.
words.sz: 度假时我们在海滩游泳。
more: Mum reads her book on the beach.
妈妈在海滩上看书。
The water at the beach is cold.
海滩的海水很凉。

words.en: Sam rides his bicycle to the park.
more: We ride our bicycles on Sunday.
我们星期天骑自行车。
Sam washes his bicycle after school.
Sam 放学后洗他的自行车。

words.en: Let's ride our bikes to the lake!
more: Mum rides her bike to work.
妈妈骑车去上班。
Sam has a small blue bike.
Sam 有一辆蓝色的自行车。

words.en: We go cycling in the countryside.
more: Cycling makes Lily happy.
骑车让 Lily 很开心。
Lily and Mia go cycling after school.
Lily 和 Mia 放学后去骑车。

words.en: Lily reads a book about dinosaurs.
words.sz: Lily 读一本关于恐龙的书。
more: I read books in my free time.
我在空闲时间看书。
Mum buys a book every month.
妈妈每月买一本书。
senses: Dad books a table for dinner.

words.en: Lily learns chess on the computer.
more: Sam plays games on Dad's computer.
Sam 在爸爸的电脑上玩游戏。
I write my story on the computer.
我在电脑上写我的故事。

words.en: We watch a DVD on Sunday evening.
words.sz: 我们星期天晚上看 DVD。
more: Lily's DVD is about the sea.
Lily 的 DVD 是讲大海的。
Can we watch this DVD again?
我们能再看这张 DVD 吗？

words.en: The DVD player is in the living room.
more: Dad puts a DVD in the DVD player.
爸爸把 DVD 放进 DVD 播放机。
Can you turn on the DVD player?
你能把 DVD 播放机打开吗？
